display_long_description:
You are the last line of defense at the border.
Everyone looks innocent… but some are hiding dangerous contraband.

Scan travelers. Inspect vehicles. Catch smugglers before they slip through.

🎯 Core Gameplay

Every decision matters.

One mistake can let a smuggler escape… or stop an innocent person.

🛂 Document Verification

Check passports for mismatches, expired data, and forged identities.
Spot small details—because smugglers rely on your mistakes.

🚗 Vehicle Inspection

Search vehicles, cargo, and hidden compartments.
Find illegal items, concealed goods, and cleverly hidden contraband.

🧍 Traveler Screening

Scan travelers for suspicious behavior and hidden threats.
Some will lie. Some will panic. Some will try to trick you.

⚠️ High-Stakes Decisions

Approve, deny, detain, or escalate.
Your choices affect security, efficiency, and what happens next.

🎮 Built for VR

Fully interactive tools, immersive environments, and intuitive controls designed for Meta Quest.

🔒 Disclaimer

This is a fictional experience created for entertainment.
